SD06-014.name: Burst Cross
SD06-014.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Brave's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit, a Brave on an opposing Brave Spirit, and an opposing Nexus. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Main effect.

[Main]
Return a card with Burst effect from your Trash to the Hand.

SD06-015.name: Burst Flame
SD06-015.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Destroy three opposing 4000 BP or less Spirits. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Destroy an opposing Brave Spirit.

SD06-017.name: Burst Storm
SD06-017.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Brave's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Return an opposing Spirit/Brave/Nexus to the deckbottom. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Refresh a Spirit you control.

SD06-016.name: Burst Wall
SD06-016.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Put a core from the Void to your Life. Then by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
When this battle ends, end the Attack Step.

SD06-004.name: Dos-Monkey
SD06-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While you have a set Burst, all your non-braved Spirits gain +3000 BP.

IZAKUCHI-WURM001.name: Ikazuchi-Wurm
IZAKUCHI-WURM001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned) Destroy an opposing Brave/Nexus.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks) If you have a set burst, you can target and attack an opposing Spirit.

[LV2] (When Attacks) For each "Dragon Warrior" family Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.

SD06-009.name: Kiji-Toria
SD06-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Turn)
While you have a set Burst, all your non-braved Spirits gain +2000 BP.

[LV2] (Opposing Start Step)
If you don't have a set Burst, you can set a card with Burst effect from your Hand.

SD06-003.name: One-Kengo
SD06-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
While you have a set Burst, treat this Spirit as LV3.

[LV2][LV3] [Clash] (When Attacks)
The opponent must block with their Spirits if possible. However, Ultimates don't have to block.

SD06-007.name: The HeroDragon Lord-Dragon
SD06-007.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this Spirit card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (After Your Burst Activates)
If the card activated was Cost 5 or less, destroy an opposing 9000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
At the end of battle, by discarding one of your Bursts, refresh this Spirit.

SD06-012.name: The HeroEmperor DeityShield
SD06-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
At the beginning of the step, target an opposing Brave Spirit. During this turn, that Brave Spirit can't battle.

[LV2]
While you have a set Burst, all your "HeroEmperor"-named Nexuses can't be destroyed.

SD06-011.name: The HeroEmperor DeitySword
SD06-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When you set Burst, draw a card. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Each non-braved "Supreme Hero" family Spirit you control gains +3000 BP. Also, while you have a Burst set, each non-braved "Supreme Hero" family Spirit you control gains +5000 BP.

CIMA-CREEK.name: The SeaDragon Cima-Creek
CIMA-CREEK.effect:
☼<nowiki>[ </nowiki>Burst: After your opponent activates a Spirit/Brave's (When Summoned) effect<nowiki> ]</nowiki>
Summon this Spirit card.

[LV1][LV2] This Spirit and Cost 2 or less Spirits cannot attack.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Turn) Each opposing Spirit can only reduce your Life by one each turn.

TWINBLADE-DRAGON.name: TwinBlade-Dragon
TWINBLADE-DRAGON.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks) Draw a card. If you have a Burst set, also, destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] Flash- (Your Attack Step) By discarding one of your Bursts, during this turn, give one of your Spirits +5000 BP.
